verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime Malgudi novel first-book-publication span from Narayan’s first published novel to The World of Nagaraj, used as a publishing proxy rather than a complete bibliography or claim of uninterrupted work.
verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use earliest English-language book publication, regardless of country or publisher—not manuscript composition, serialization, later national editions, retitling, reissues or translations. Narayan composed these works in English. Swami and Friends circulated in manuscript before its 1935 British book; it later appeared with The Bachelor of Arts in a 1957 U.S. volume. The English Teacher’s 1945 book became Grateful to Life and Death in a 1953 U.S. edition; The Financial Expert likewise reached the United States in 1953 after its 1952 British book. None of the selected markers is a serialization or posthumous first release. Later non-Malgudi fiction and posthumous collections do not extend this scoped bar.
verifiedScope.chartRange: Narayan’s 1906–2001 lifespan falls within the collection-derived chart domain, so no chart-range change was required.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
